Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Uma Chauhan. I am a 73-year-old schoolteacher living in Pune. My employer M/s Goyal Industries owes me ₹22,80,000 after firing me, and the employee was dismissed without any enquiry. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 60028 14419 or email uma.chauhan@example.in.
